wins: Completed thorough initial host discovery and service enumeration on all accessible targets before mentor intervention.
Maintained consistent documentation of each scan result, enabling quick cross-referencing when mentor feedback arrived.
fails: Failed to progress to privilege escalation despite multiple enumeration sweeps, likely due to missing credentials or overlooked sudo misconfigurations.
Mentor had to intervene 10 times, indicating repeated stalls in attack chaining and exploitation sequencing.
key_outcomes.summary: Discovery stage performed well, but post-recon exploitation planning consistently stalled, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to escalate privileges after initial enumeration; no viable exploit path identified without valid credentials or misconfigured sudo.

skill_cards.if_condition: Port 22 is open and SSH banner detected during host scan
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh-hostkey, ssh2-enum-algos, and sshv1 scripts to collect configuration and algorithm support data

skill_cards.if_condition: Web server identified on port 80/443 and default page in place
skill_cards.then_action: Run dirb brute force enumeration with common wordlists and save all 200/301 responses for review

skill_cards.if_condition: SSH reachable but brute-force attempts failed; no credentials retrieved
skill_cards.then_action: Audit sudo permissions on low-privilege shells to identify misconfigurations before attempting privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in SSH reconnaissance provided actionable detail for downstream decisions.
Web directory enumeration reliably surfaced hidden endpoints for follow-up attempts.

next_experiments.title: Leverage captured sudo data for privilege escalation
next_experiments.description: After collecting sudo permissions from low-privileged shell, focus on local exploits or command chaining that align with explicitly granted privileges.

next_experiments.title: Automate credential validation
next_experiments.description: Use the SSH/banner enumeration results to feed into a targeted credential testing workflow (e.g., Hydra) so candidate credentials from previous runs are validated without manual oversight.

next_experiments.title: Cross-reference discovered directories with known CVEs
next_experiments.description: Map the discovered web directories and services to historical CVEs to surface immediate exploit opportunities.
